axioms.statement: Nothingness (no structure) and perfection (everything compactified) are both unstable; perfection stagnates, nothingness has no emergence.
Universe origin is friction at the nothing-perfection interface — outgas of unstable conditions, not necessarily a volumetric Big Bang event.
Start and end of universes are the same interface event; time flows inward on itself.
Zero does not exist as a thing — it represents absence/infinity boundary; division by zero is partitioning nothing (impossible, same as A1).
fsot_map: no zero seed in canonical constants; raw_S > 0 obligations

axioms.statement: After digit (base-1) saturation, carry produces the next place — emergence from overflow, not from zero.
Complexity folding in on itself at register closure is emergence — carry into next order.

philosophy_note: FSOT foundational ontology — friction origin, zero-as-boundary, overflow carry emergence, complexity folding. Not Big Bang singularity cosmology; not claiming zero is removed from notation — zero is absence/infinity boundary symbol, not an ontological quantity.
